description: Get one episode of a TV show by show id + season number + episode number: overview, air date, runtime, TMDB vote average (`vote_average`, TMDB's own 0-10 user score — not an IMDb/RT/Metacritic score; get_movie/get_tv's `ratings` are whole-show only and this tool makes no OMDb call), guest stars (up to 15) and director/writer. Also returns the episode's own `imdb_id`/`imdb_url` — pass that id to get_ratings for this one episode's IMDb rating, the only way to get a per-episode IMDb score here. Get the show id from search_tv.
name: get_tv_episode

imdb_id.description: This episode's own IMDb id (not the show's) — pass it to get_ratings for the episode's IMDb rating, which no TMDB field carries. Null when TMDB has no IMDb id for it.

vote_average.description: TMDB's own 0-10 user score. A different audience and scale from the IMDb/RT/Metacritic scores get_movie/get_tv return as `ratings` — don't compare, average or substitute across the two.

title: Get TV episode
